# Run:     GitHub Actions "CMake Build" run 39030237929, job Goldens

# Source:  src/effects/PhaserFilter.h (the signal processing of

#          rust/dsp/goldens/capture/phaser.cpp.
# Run:     GitHub Actions "CMake Build" run 39032958461, job Goldens

# Source:  src/effects/WahwahFilter.h (the signal processing of

# Record format - one record per line, "#" starts a comment:
#   design <kind> <order> <fn> <fc> <ripple> <subtype> <n> <5*n coeffs>
#   chebypoly <order> <x> <value>
#   process-design <kind> <order> <fn> <fc> <ripple> <subtype> <len> <samples>
#   process-weighting <fs> <len> <samples>
#   ebur128 <rate> <channels> <nsamples> <seed> <mode> <loudness>
#   bt-coeffs <rate> <shelf> <hz> <slope> <gain> <a0> <a1> <a2> <b0> <b1> <b2>
#   bt-block <rate> <bass> <treble> <gain> <len> <samples>
#   ph-block <rate> <stages> <drywet> <freq> <phase> <depth> <feedback>
#            <outgain> <len> <stride> <samples>
#   wah-block <rate> <freq> <phase> <depth> <res> <freqofs> <outgain>
#             <len> <stride> <samples>
#   dis-block <rate> <table> <dcblock> <threshold> <noisefloor> <param1>
#             <param2> <repeats> <len> <stride> <samples>
#
# The bt-block, ph-block, wah-block and dis-block records were run with an
# input that is generated from the sample index by integer arithmetic narrowed
# to float, rather than stored here, so a test reproduces it on any platform;
# the dumper that produced each record is in rust/dsp/goldens/capture/.  The
# dis-block input spans -1 to 1, which is the whole of the lookup table that
# shapes it, ends included.
#
# Numbers are printed with %.17g, which round trips doubles exactly; the
# bt-block, ph-block, wah-block and dis-block samples are floats and are
# printed with %.9g.
